  Inspect an example
  
input          target
failure        park — exhausted failures hold for u resume
loop           check ↺ inspect · max 2 · span inspect → check
agent          each job's profile · prompt steps shared unless fresh
prompts        up to 4 prompts per generation (2 step attempts + 2 extra loop attempts) · cap per job, see used by
timeout        per run, set by each job · default 2h0m0s
commands       allowed

       Inspect {{input}}
 ▸2. check  command · retry 0 · ↺ inspect ×2
       true
 ▸3. summarize  prompt fresh
       Summarize {{previous}}
